payload.text: After clearout-1121: file a second issue beside todo 76 (devbin-vc's ask, 2026-11-24), fix in 0.1.32: a tool's publish writes .devbin-tool into the published tree and keg, but the tool's install manifest (eg .gtools-install) does not list it, so doctor notes an unlisted file and upgrade does not carry it. Fix: the publish lists .devbin-tool in its manifest. One localised arm, red at main, green at the fix. Send vc both ids.
